title: lanes.status
description: Return the latest cached snapshot of development lanes (git worktrees) and whether each is active or idle, derived from git worktree state. No params. Returns { lanes, fetched_at_ms, stale, gh_available }. Each lane carries { name, path, branch, is_main, dirty_count, last_commit_ms, last_commit_msg, last_activity_ms, state, pr }. last_commit_msg is the HEAD commit subject (null if the worktree has no commits). pr is { number, state, url } resolved from `gh pr list` on a separate 60s cadence, or null (always null for the main worktree, for branches with no PR, and whenever gh is unavailable). gh_available is false when gh could not be consulted — consumers render absent/null pr fields as "—".
